newsitem.title: USA: Orbital, Siemens to hold news conference.
newsitem.headline: Orbital, Siemens to hold news conference.

text.p: Orbital Engine Corp said Wednesday it plans to hold a joint news conference with Siemens Automotive Corp at 1200 EST and will release a statement between 1100 and 1200 EST.
A company spokeswoman declined to give further information. Trading of the company's stock was halted.

Earlier, a source close to Orbital told Reuters the company is expected to announce the formation of an alliance with Siemens to develop fuel injection technology. The announcement was expected at the Society of Automotive Engineers World Conference later today in Detroit.
